project.name: plumb-app
project.description:
LAYER 3 -- the applications. These are the entry points; nothing in the layers below depends on them.
- plumb-main the CLI (SastMain), the scan runner that dispatches source files to the right frontend, and the source-less consumer entry point (IrAnalysisRunner). - plumb-build the build-introspection modules: how was this project actually compiled?
plumb-main depends on the engine layer, so it is where the frontends become reachable from a real scan.
